The 4b0f86e lock rewrite dropped the @emnapi entries
@unrs/resolver-binding-wasm32-wasi pins, so npm ci fails under both
npm 10 and 11 and CI's Install step reds before any check runs. A
tree without the branch's ajv 8 entry compiles registry.ts against
main's hoisted ajv 6 declarations, which is exactly the three
typecheck errors CI reported (instancePath, Ajv as a type). The lock
is regenerated with npm 10.9.4, verified under npm 10.9.4 and 11.6.2,
and registry.ts's ajv error and option typing is structural so it
typechecks under either major's declarations.
